resources.string: USB drive · videos, music and photos
NAS, router with a drive, Linux or Mac computer

Start the address with the protocol: sftp://nas/Movies · ftp://192.168.0.10 · ftps://nas/Videos · nfs://nas/volume1/video. SFTP and FTPS are encrypted; plain FTP sends the password unencrypted, so use it only at home. NFS has no password: the NAS must allow the TV\'s IP and connections from non-privileged ports.
Start with sftp://, ftp://, ftps:// or nfs://, followed by the server and the folder. Username and password go in their own fields.
The NFS server refused the TV. On the NAS, allow connections from non-privileged ports (Linux: the \"insecure\" option in /etc/exports).
The NFS server did not allow this TV. On the NAS, add the TV\'s IP (or your home network) to this folder\'s NFS rule.
This server\'s key has changed since it was added. If you reinstalled the server, remove it here and add it again; if not, someone may be impersonating it.
The TV did not give the launcher access to the USB drive. Try again in a moment.
